audit.why: TRICKY at 46.01% over 1380 games. Mel owns pre-6 poke; Diana's 6 and first item flip the lane into assassin roulette — matches the rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content mislabels Diana's ult: it calls Lunar Rush her R and her level-6 spike. Lunar Rush is her E (dash, 22s, resets off Moonlight, available from early levels); her R is Moonfall (pull + burst). Also win[4] (Level 6) says Mel while full phases[4].side says Diana — the two layers disagree on the row.
audit.why: Riot kit: E Lunar Rush 22/20/18/16/14s dash; R Moonfall 100/90/80s pull. The page's own spikes[1] says 'everything flips at 6', full layer rates Diana 7/10 there — Level 6 belongs to Diana; the content row and its why were the stale half.
audit.corrected: win[4] Mel->Diana with whys[4] rewritten; Lunar Rush/Moonfall corrected in whys, spikes[1], late, wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad verbatim; 21 misgendered fields (Diana is she/her). Reflect scope unstated: only Crescent Strike (Q) is reflectable — Lunar Rush and Moonfall are not projectiles.
audit.why: Kit: Q 8s-6s arc projectile; E dash no-cooldown when reset off Moonlight; W Pale Cascade 15s-9s shield that changes all-in math; R 100s.

notes: Core fix: content had Lunar Rush (Diana's E dash) labeled as her R/level-6 spike; her actual R is Moonfall (pull + AoE burst). Corrected in whys[4-5], spikes[1], late, wants.foe[0]. Level 6 row: full said Diana, content said Mel — moved win[4] to Diana with a matching why (the page's own spikes[1] and the full layer both call 6 Diana's flip; the packet levelChart showing Mel at index 4 looks stale and would deepen the chart-vs-46% WR defect). Rows 0-3 and 5-6: content already correct, full sides edited alone. All 22 lint findings fixed. Packet defect (chart 5/7 Mel vs 46% WR) partially addressed by the level-6 flip; remaining tilt reflects genuine pre-6 lane control vs post-6 losses — noted, not forced.
